title: Reviewer terminal and checklist ownership
description: Manual production gateway and public harness proof. Requires an existing tmux server; never starts or kills the server.

terminal-proof.intent: A real reviewer keeps its checklist until its own terminal mark; explicit host overrides and blocked start remain usable.

runner-exit-proof.intent: An observed reviewer crash preserves its partial output, consumes a second review round and relaunches once; only the replacement terminal mark completes the review.
